items.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director says he "did his best" to fight for a full disc release
items.description:
Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi has responded to fans asking for a full disc version of the game, saying he "did [his] best" to push for physical media as the industry edges towards an all-digital future.

Read more

items.title: Sony in talks to land Battlefield movie from Christopher McQuarrie and Michael B. Jordan
items.description:
Sony is reportedly in talks to acquire a big-screen adaptation of Electronic Arts' Battlefield, with Christopher McQuarrie attached to write, direct and produce, and Michael B. Jordan on board to produce.

Read more

items.title: Capcom plans to evolve RE Engine into an "AI-generation game engine"
items.description:
Capcom wants to transform its in-house RE Engine into what it's calling an "AI-generation game engine".

Read more

items.title: Metro Redux's Next-Gen Update arrives this month as franchise passes 50 million sales
items.description:
A free next-gen update is coming to Metro 2033 Redux and Metro Last Light Redux on 22nd October for PC (29th October for consoles).

Read more

items.title: Memory shortages set to persist into 2028, warns Micron CEO
items.description:
Micron has warned that global RAM shortages show no sign of easing, telling investors on its earnings call that it has already sold most of next year's production.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6's 18+ age rating reveals Lucia and Jason can partake in drug use "directly from their inventory" and "at any time"
items.description:
GTA 6 is seemingly adding another naughty pastime to the series' already mammoth collection of naughty pastimes. Joining the strip clubs and violent car-jackings and carefree murder is "frequent and prominent" drug use that you can try "at any time," according to a new age rating.

Read more

items.title: "This is your Dreamcast moment": Former PlayStation boss thinks Xbox needs to "pick a lane" with exclusive games to fix itself
items.description:
Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden has some thoughts on where Team Xbox is at right now and where the green machine can go from here, but the console maker needs to "pick a lane" with exclusive games, either way.

Read more

items.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 boss hopes GTA 6 pushes game prices up because it's "long overdue and also necessary for this business to survive"
items.description:
Warhorse Studios co-founder Martin Klima - the developer behind last year's historical RPG Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 - is crossing his fingers for higher game prices, and he thinks GTA 6 might be the one to usher in a new normal.

Read more

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 may be the first GTA to have full-on "sex scenes", Hot Coffee not included
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 may feature actual sex scenes. The suggestion comes from an age-rating description for GTA 6 on the PlayStation Store, which states - if viewing the New Zealand or Australian versions of the Store - there are "sex scenes" in the game.

Read more

items.title: Halo's new steward Activision reportedly considering rebooting the series, with a team in Sledgehammer Games leading the charge
items.description:
We recently learned that Microsoft gave development of its next Halo game to Activision, where "a new purpose-built team" - separate from the teams working on Call of Duty - has been created to oversee the franchise going forward. Now, in a report from well-known Halo and Xbox insider Rebs Gaming, a possible timeline about how the process progressed internally at Microsoft has started to take form. And the report suggests that Activision's take on Xbox's premiere sci-fi shooter will be a reboot of the series -one that possibly explores Master Chief's origins.

Read more

items.title: CD Projekt Red addresses divisive lighting changes in a new Witcher 3 Remastered PC patch
items.description:
A second hotfix has been released for The Witcher 3 Remastered edition that directly addresses lighting concerns on PC, as well as a couple of other notable issues.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day is missing iconic features like chainsaw duels and meat shields, but The Coalition says we shouldn't worry - they're "not gone from the franchise"
items.description:
Gears of War: E-Day arrived for early adopters yesterday, available for anyone who bought either the Premium Edition, Premium Upgrade Edition, or Collector's Edition version of the game. As it arrived, however, some players noted 'missing' features that have appeared in past Gears games, but not in The Coalition's latest.

Read more

items.title: PS5 gets "AI-guided upscaling" a bit like PS5 Pro's, and it's available now in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei
items.description:
AI image upscaling is coming to PlayStation 5, Sony has announced, and it's available already in two games: Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei.

Read more

items.title: Aion 2's imminent worldwide release could be huge as early access founders' packs outsell major games, and player numbers soar
items.description:
Aion 2's much-awaited worldwide release is days away, following its release in Korea and Taiwan roughly a year ago. Despite this, the MMO has soared - high up Steam's most played game chart.

Read more

items.title: 007 First Light gets free new DLC today, adding New Game Plus and Photo modes, new TacSim missions and more
items.description:
James Bond game 007 First Light is getting free DLC today in an Extended Operations update. This adds much-asked-for features to the game - such as New Game Plus, a new harder difficulty mode, a photo mode - as well as more TacSim mission challenges and a couple of game adjustments

Read more

items.title: Ace Combat 8 developer apologises for Belkan War pre-order backlash, explains why it happened and vows to explore possible solutions
items.description:
The early access launch of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve kicked off on a down note due to some confusion regarding one of the game's pre-order bonuses. Pre-orders of the flight action game include a copy of 2006's Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War, but early adopters discovered it was not a standalone product, contrary to what they were lead to believe when they pre-ordered the game.

Read more
category: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War

items.title: Witcher 3 Remastered patch addressing "various lighting adjustments" rolls out
items.description:
Since The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered's launch earlier this week, the debate around its lighting changes - whether it's overly brightened and washed out - has waged on. Now, CD Projekt Red has rolled out a patch for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, and the game's PC Xbox Play Anywhere version, which makes "various lighting adjustments" among other things.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone

items.title: Krafton pulls the plug on another PUBG game, Black Budget, less than a year after it was announced
items.description:
PUBG publisher Krafton announced today it is ending development of PUBG: Black Budget, the extraction shooter spin-off announced nearly a year ago.

Read more

items.title: New Uncharted game reportedly in the works at Naughty Dog, and it's not a remake
items.description:
Uncharted series developer Naughty Dog is reportedly early in development on a new game in the action-adventure series. That's according to a report from MP1st, which said the game is bringing back series protagonist Nathan Drake in some form, suggesting he may not be the game's lead.

Read more

items.title: Here are our PS Plus monthly games for October 2026
items.description:
Sony has revealed the games coming this month to PlayStation Plus, which are available to everyone from 6th October.

Read more

items.title: The Division studio Massive expands to take control of Splinter Cell and Ghost Recon, and a new IP, in Ubisoft's most recent reorganisation
items.description:
Ubisoft has expanded the remit of Swedish studio Massive Entertainment - responsible for The Division series, Star Wars Outlaws and Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora - to become a second major part of the company and include more of its studios and game brands. Ubisoft also revealed Massive's work on a brand new, original game called March of Giants.

Read more

items.title: Former Halo lead suggests three ways Activision could revive the legendary series, and urges the company to hire laid off Bungie staff
items.description:
Halo's ex-franchise director, Frank O'Connor, has given Activision a few pointers now that it's in charge of making the next Halo game with a "purpose-built team." Top of the list, hire some devs who were laid off from Bungie and Halo Studios.

Read more

items.title: "Xbox is not for sale": CEO Asha Sharma says "we will do whatever it takes" to turn the console maker's fortunes around
items.description:
Despite mass layoffs at multiple first-party studios and major internal shakeups, CEO Asha Sharma has shot down speculation about a potential Xbox buyout.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 completely "re-engineered" Rockstar's weather systems to "achieve a sense of scale we haven't felt before," adding hurricanes, rainbows and heavy rain
items.description:
If you thought Red Dead Redemption 2's heavy winds and even heavier rain looked impressive, you might be happy to learn that Rockstar Games went back and "re-engineered our weather system" for GTA 6. Hurricanes, rainbows and "vertiginous cumulonimbus clouds" are all part of the upcoming open worlder.

Read more

items.title: It's not even out yet, but Valve's Deadlock just became one of the most played games on Steam
items.description:
Valve's new MOBA Deadlock - a sort of cross between Dota and Overwatch - might not be fully released yet, or even accessible by vast portions of the public,but that hasn't stopped its latest update propelling it to being one of the most played games on Steam.

Read more

items.title: Tinker, Bard, Illusionist - Blizzard seemingly surveying World of Warcraft: Forever players about never-before-seen classes to add to the game
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever players claim to have been sent a survey asking whether they'd be interested in a variety of new classes for the upcoming MMO - and some of them are very interesting.

Read more

items.title: "My god this new lighting is lifeless" - The Witcher 3 Remastered Edition divides players for a few key reasons
items.description:
Yesterday's free Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered upgrade might have propelled the old role-playing game to new heights, in terms of player popularity, but not everyone is happy with what's changed. A particular point of contention concerns the game's new lighting changes, which some people think has made The Witcher 3 too bright and washed out - though this is not the only issue.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone

items.title: As handholding mechanics come under fire elsewhere, Control Resonant devs confirm they made a "conscious decision" not to use yellow paint
items.description:
Control Resonant is one of the few modern open-world games which doesn't always point you to where you should go next. This desire to give players time to figure their way around is the reason why, according to the game's director, Resonant does not have yellow paint.

Read more

items.title: Monster Hunter Wilds on Switch 2 runs at a stable 30FPS, but it took Capcom a "painstaking, seemingly endless process" to get there
items.description:
A lot has already been said of Monster Hunter Wilds' upcoming Switch 2 port. The game, with all its free DLC updates - including new monsters - will be available 5th December, arriving with local co-op support to harken back to those old Gathering Hall days on the PSP or 3DS (if you're an old-head, like me).

Read more

items.title: Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown DLC delayed by two weeks "to deliver a more polished and stable gameplay experience"
items.description:
Crimson Desert developer Pearl Abyss today announced it's delaying Charting the Unknown, the game's first post-launch add-on. Previously set for release 15th October, the DLC's release date has been pushed back to 29th October - a two-week delay.

Read more

items.title: Xbox Mythic Achievements roll out to Insiders and are retroactively awarded as far back as Xbox 360 games
items.description:
The rumoured Xbox Mythic Achievements - the equivalent of PlayStation's Platinum Trophies - have been officially announced, and they're rolling out for Xbox Insiders now.

Read more

items.title: Xbox's disc-to-digital feature rolls out for Series consoles and Xbox One, allowing you to digitise your game-disc collection
items.description:
After about a month in testing, Xbox's disc-to-digital feature has officially launched for all owners of Xbox consoles. The feature allows users to turn Xbox One and Xbox Series X discs into digital copies.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is getting a Counter-Strike-inspired game mode that I can't believe it never had before
items.description:
On top of featuring all the game modes you expect from a Call of Duty game, Modern Warfare 4 is courting the competitive scene with something entirely new for the series: a game mode called Collateral.

Read more

items.title: The Witcher 3 surges to its highest Steam concurrent player-count ever, following Remastered edition's release
items.description:
The Witcher 3's newly released Remastered edition has dramatically rekindled interest in the 11-year-old role-playing game, which is currently enjoying its highest concurrent player-count on Steam ever.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone

items.title: You can now watch one of this year's best orchestral game-music performances, celebrating Hades 1 and 2, online for free
items.description:
The outrageously enjoyable Hades musical orchestral concert, Ballads of the Underworld, is now available to watch in its entirety, online, for free.

Read more

items.title: Don't worry if you're struggling in human form in The Blood of Dawnwalker - "it should be harder" playing that way
items.description:
If you've been playing Medieval vampire RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker and you're wondering why you're having a hard time during the day, as a human, versus as at night as a vampire, then don't worry: you're experiencing the game as intended. It's not supposed to be balanced, apparently.

Read more

items.title: Controversy erupts around Ace Combat 8 on PC as bundled Belkan War re-release remains problematically attached to the new game, whereas it's standalone on console
items.description:
Early access to Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is now available to owners of the game's Deluxe Edition, but the launch has been soured due to publisher Bandai Namco's handling of one particular pre-order bonus.

Read more
category: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War

items.title: Mexican lawmakers join the fight for digital games ownership with a new consumer rights initiative
items.description:
Another country has entered the fray as ongoing debates around digital video game ownership ignite across the world.

Read more

items.title: The Elder Scrolls Online is partly why Skyrim never got a Fallout: New Vegas-style spin-off, says Bethesda veteran
items.description:
Why did The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim never receive a spin-off like Bethesda's Fallout 3 did, with Fallout: New Vegas? According to Skyrim co-lead designer Kurt Kuhlmann, it's because of The Elder Scrolls Online. Speaking to FRVR (via VGC), the 20-year studio veteran said the MMORPG essentially kept Elder Scrolls fans occupied while Bethesda focused on other projects.

Read more

items.title: All versions of The Witcher 3 "that exist in the world" will be upgraded with the free Remastered edition today
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has clarified to Eurogamer that "all versions of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt that exist in the world" are to be updated with the free Remastered edition upgrade today. That update, by the way, rolls out from 11am BST.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Blood and Wine
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Hearts of Stone

items.title: Sony is introducing an anti-scalping lottery system for PS5 Pros in Japan as supply shortages persist
items.description:
Sony is introducing a lottery system for PS5 Pros on its Japanese online store for when demand for new consoles outstrips the limited supply.

Read more

items.title: Naughty Dog confirms two more The Last of Us projects are in the works, won't show off Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet until 2027
items.description:
Naughty Dog fans, pick up your ears - it's been a busy night for fans of the PlayStation studio. First of all, in a letter celebrating The Last of Us Day 2026, studio head Neil Druckmann confirmed that two new projects within The Last of Us universe are in the "very early stages" of development at Naughty Dog.

Read more

items.title: In another unprecedented move, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is changing double XP tokens so they count down in match and not real-time
items.description:
Just days after announcing a silly skin off toggle for Call of Duty: Warzone, Activision has returned to share some even better news for Modern Warfare 4. At launch and beyond, double XP tokens will count down only when you're actively in a match, not in real-world time.

Read more

items.title: Double Fine's releasing its next game, Thank You Bus Driver, just months after splitting from Xbox
items.description:
Double Fine's wasted no time at all as an independent game studio (again) after splitting from former owner Xbox earlier this summer. The storied developer is releasing its whacky driving sim, Thank You Bus Driver, in roughly two weeks time.

Read more

items.title: "What if London existed in the Grand Theft Auto universe?" One fan has answered with a GTA-style map of the city
items.description:
"What if London existed in the Grand Theft Auto universe? What if Rockstar created a GTA game set in London?" Anyone sitting in the venn diagram centre of GTA fan and cartography sicko might be happy to learn that YouTuber CityEd has answered both of those questions with a GTA-style map.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft's calling its next push into gen-AI game development Motherbrain
items.description:
Ubisoft is internally calling its latest generative-AI initiative 'Motherbrain' - you know, like the evil supercomputer turned gross brain-in-a-jar monster from Nintendo's Metroid series - according to trademarks filed by the Assassin's Creed and Far Cry publisher.

Read more

items.title: Dark Souls 2 can now be played in its entirety with drop-in, drop-out co-op, thanks to its own seamless multiplayer mod
items.description:
The popular - and always appreciated - seamless co-op mod has finally come to Dark Souls 2: Scholar of the First Sin, the only game of the trilogy to have spent years without it. Mod creator Yui, who's responsible for the seamless co-op mods for Dark Souls Remastered, Dark Souls 3, Elden Ring and Armored Core has returned to release the mod's alpha version to the public.

Read more
category: Dark Souls 2: Scholar of the First Sin

items.title: If you want an early taste of The Witcher 3's Songs of the Past expansion, you can listen to five tracks from the OST right now
items.description:
Back in August, CD Projekt Red properly revealed new Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past during Gamescom's Opening Night Live show. Whilst I got to experience a hands-off demo of the new content (which I loved), no one in the public has yet had chance to get their hands on the title. So, it seems like CD Projekt Red is doing the next best thing and get our, erm, ears on it instead.

Read more
category: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past

items.title: Blizzard gifts Diablo 4 players one of the game's rarest crafting materials to apologise for Season 15 issues
items.description:
Diablo 4's Season of Hell's Legacy began over two weeks ago following a banner BlizzCon, but its launch has been surprisingly wobbly. The season initially suffered a multi-hour delay thanks to log-in errors and server issues, but Blizzard has apologised to players using the power of gifts.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Warzone will soon make it possible to toggle all those silly skins off, something no one thought could ever happen
items.description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is introducing a highly-requested feature to Warzone later this year. With the launch of the game's first season, players will be able to turn off character skins from other Call of Duty games in the free-to-play mode.

Read more

items.title: As World of Warcraft: Forever's beta popularity grows, Blizzard has yet again had to increase the server cap
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's beta appears to be growing in popularity, as one of Blizzard's leads has revealed the server capacity had to be increased over the weekend.

Read more

items.title: Marvel's Wolverine finally lets you turn off "fart gas" scent trails completely, but there's a catch
items.description:
Marvel's Wolverine has received a new update that should hopefully bring an end to the "fart gas" scent trails saga. The latest patch, version 1.001.006, includes an option to turn off scent trails for Whiskey Bottle collectibles, Material Crate audio pings as well as Nightmare Door roots using three separate toggles in the Gameplay menu.

Read more

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's is coming to Fortnite for Fortnitemares
items.description:
Epic has confirmed that Five Nights at Freddy's is joining Fortnite for this year's Fortnitemares event.

Read more

items.title: Xbox is reportedly paying a "fraction" of the $400 million Kojima quoted Sony for Physint
items.description:
A reported $400 million budget for Hideo Kojima's Physint has already been walked back over the weekend, with multiple outlets now saying Xbox is paying nowhere near that figure for Hideo Kojima's stealth game.

Read more

items.title: Minecraft is getting its first new dimension in 14 years, and it's called The Sift
items.description:
Minecraft maker Mojang has announced The Sift, a new Minecraft dimension that will join the Overworld, the Nether, and The End when it launches on Java and Bedrock in 2027. It's the first new dimension added to the game since The End arrived in 2011.

Read more

items.title: Final Fantasy 7 director says Revelation's Platinum trophy will be "easier to get"
items.description:
While Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth was "difficult" to Platinum by "design", sequel Revelation's Platinum trophy will be "easier to get".

Read more

items.title: Minecraft still gains around 300,000 new players a day, Xbox boss reveals
items.description:
More than 300,000 try Minecraft for the first time every single day.

Read more

items.title: Microsoft CEO says Xbox's "streamlining" is "great to see" despite cuts and layoffs
items.description:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has praised Xbox's ongoing "streamlining" under Xbox CEO Asha Sharma just days after another round of layoffs hit the division.

Read more

items.title: Castlevania celebrates turning 40 by giving away the original game for free
items.description:
In celebration of the 40th(!!) anniversary of Castlevania, Konami is giving away the original 1986 game for free on the App Store and Google Play.

Read more

items.title: MobyGames video game database now lets developers claim their game credits
items.description:
Video game database MobyGames will let developers claim video game credits and customise their personal portfolios, albeit only via a new premium tier.

Read more

items.title: US court orders Redditor to pay Nintendo £3.4m over Switch piracy
items.description:
A US District Judge has granted Nintendo a £3.4 million ($4.5m) default judgment against James Williams, the former Reddit moderator known online as "Archbox", after he failed to respond to a lawsuit over alleged Nintendo Switch piracy.

Read more

items.title: Skyrim loremaster says The Elder Scrolls never got a Fallout: New Vegas-style game because Bethesda is "very protective" over its golden goose
items.description:
Skyrim launched almost 15 years ago while The Elder Scrolls 6 is still marinating over at Bethesda Game Studios. Even so, Bethesda apparently never considered having an outside team develop a spin-off game to fill that painfully long gap - as it did once upon a time with Obsidian's Fallout: New Vegas.

Read more

items.title: Resident Evil Requiem's made over $500m since release, but the new film didn't have as big of an impact as Capcom's price drops
items.description:
Resident Evil Requiem is still doing bonkers business while elongating Capcom's generational win streak, but the new big-screen reboot didn't make as big of an impact on game sales as you might expect. Still, according to estimates from Alinea Analytics, the ninth mainline game in the horror series has made over $500m (around £377m) and counting.

Read more

items.title: Control Resonant's post-launch plan includes a Photo Mode and New Game Plus Plus coming next month: "Do 665 runs if you want!"
items.description:
Control Resonant's upside down world is out now, but Remedy Entertainment's not done with the RPG just yet. The Alan Wake and Max Payne maker has detailed some of its post-launch plans for the game, which currently include new outfits, a Photo Mode and a New Game Plus Plus option for anyone who wants to carry their progress over into neverending playthroughs.

Read more

items.title: Ubisoft's Mario + Rabbids team reportedly came close to making an "ambitious" Zelda game starring Ganondorf, but it wasn't to be
items.description:
Ubisoft Milan, the studio behind the acclaimed Mario + Rabbids games, reportedly came close to making a Zelda spin-off starring the series' biggest villain, Ganondorf, instead of regular protagonist Link - but an initially receptive Nintendo eventually pulled the plug on the whole thing.

Read more
category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

items.title: Arc Raiders announces a new PvE "test" to accommodate its surprisingly friendly players
items.description:
Embark Studios has announced a new matchmaking test for Arc Raiders that'll allow players to opt into a PvE version featuring none of the usual player-versus-player violence. It's the developer's response to a growing portion of the playerbase apparently uninterested in hurting their raiders-in-arms.

Read more

items.title: After nearly 19 years in development hell, Ubisoft's Beyond Good & Evil 2 is somehow still showing signs of life
items.description:
Sound the alarm! Alert your loved ones! Nearly 18 years after its original announcement, Beyond Good & Evil 2 apparently still isn't dead, according to a Ubisoft Bordeaux developer who says he's been working on the game for months.

Read more

items.title: It took roughly two years and "one of the most expensive art assets ever" to get Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty's Chimera tank fight right
items.description:
CD Projekt Red has shared some insight into Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty's fantastic Chimera tank boss fight, explaining it took two years to get the complicated sequence right.

Read more

items.title: GTA veteran's MindsEye studio Build a Rocket Boy has entered administration, following yet more reports of layoffs
items.description:
Last week brought reports of further layoffs at Build A Rocket Boy, the beleaguered studio behind the poorly received 2025 shooter MindsEye. In the wake of that news, the company - which has repeatedly attempted to blame its woes on 'sabouteurs' - has filed for administration.

Read more

items.title: Sony reportedly surveying developers about PlayStation disc-ending decision - is it having second thoughts?
items.description:
Is Sony having second thoughts about ending PlayStation disc support? The question has arisen following a report that says Sony sent "a bigger survey than they've sent almost ever before" to developers asking for feedback about the decision to stop producing disc-based games.

Read more

items.title: As Marathon's player slump continues, Bungie announces plans to grow it "beyond extraction"
items.description:
Bungie has announced drastic changes coming to its struggling shooter Marathon, including a shift away from its extraction roots in the coming months. The new mission statement? Making more "approachable" experiences with "different levels of intensity and commitment."

Read more

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker's divisive time mechanic was once much stricter, but it was loosened because of "fear" around the game
items.description:
I've had a hunch ever since playing The Blood of Dawnwalker that its divisive time limit feature - whereby you have 30 in-game days and nights to save your character's family from a nasty pack of vampires - isn't as strict as Rebel Wolves once intended it. And it turns out I was right.

Read more

items.title: Rockstar reveals a £350 box of naughty GTA 6 collectables you definitely wouldn't get through airport security
items.description:
Rockstar Games has announced a limited Goodtime State Vice City collection of goodies for Grand Theft Auto 6 that's ludicrously expensive - £349 - doesn't include a copy of the game, and is pre-orderable now.

Read more

items.title: "I assume someone is being greedy somewhere" - Tim Schafer discusses  current game industry woes following Double Fine's split with Xbox
items.description:
Tim Schafer - the founder of acclaimed developer Double Fine Productions, and the legendary designer behind the likes of Day of the Tentacle and Psychonauts - has spoken out about his studio's recent shift to independence, as well as Game Pass, and industry woes at large.

Read more

items.title: Quake Champions ditches free-to-play and kills off its Microsoft Store version eight years after its original release
items.description:
In an unusual move, developer id Software's free-to-play shooter Quake Champions is transitioning into a paid product, eight years after its original release. As part of the same move, the Microsoft studio is killing off the Microsoft Store version, meaning it's now only available on Steam.

Read more

items.title: Xbox's version of PlayStation's Platinum Trophy achievement seems to leak, and it's got a sound-effect that's 15 seconds long
items.description:
I'm not sure what's more surprising: that Xbox never had a Platinum Trophy equivalent, that Xbox feels the need to have a Platinum Trophy equivalent, or that it's adding a Platinum Trophy equivalent now while restructuring the company.

Read more

items.title: Player discovers game-changing pair of pants in World of Warcraft: Forever
items.description:
The times when a pair of pants prove newsworthy are tragically rare, and when they are it's usually not a good thing. Thankfully, a community discovery in World of Warcraft: Forever has remedied that.

Read more

items.title: Don't expect regular Destiny 2 updates to return, despite the surprise "unvaulting" of game additions
items.description:
After announcing the end of Destiny 2 development and laying off almost the game's entire team, Bungie surprised fans earlier this week with news that it's working on "unvaulting" Destiny 2 campaigns, raids and destinations - bringing them back to the game after they were removed. The developer offered few specifics at the time, but new information has now emerged about what we can expect.

Read more

items.title: Discord launches controversial age-verification system "using the most privacy-preserving approach we could build" months after first delay
items.description:
Discord delayed the rollout of its controversial age verification system back in February after very loud backlash against the company's plans. Those age checks are now back, but this time, co-founder and chief technology officer Stanislav Vishnevskiy says the updated system will give users options that aren't as invasive.

Read more

items.title: As Halo goes to Activision, fans worry about a potential lore reboot from the Call of Duty publisher, but at least Halo Fest lives on
items.description:
UPDATE 25/09/26: Halo Studios' esports lead has confirmed December's Halo Fest lives on, despite layoffs sweeping through the rest of the developer. Further updates about the live event might take a little while to come our way as the studio is busy providing "support and care for our teammates," understandably. I've left the full statement below.

Read more

items.title: Obsidian's "creative identity and strengths" will remain intact, promises Bethesda, as it takes control of Fallout: New Vegas studio
items.description:
Xbox's massive and still ongoing reorganisation has pushed Obsidian Entertainment under Bethesda's umbrella. Despite the quite drastic corporate shakeup, Bethesda's president is promising folks the iconic RPG developer will hold onto its "creative identity."

Read more

items.title: Beloved cockney-orc Lord of the Rings games Shadow of Mordor and Shadow of War finally make their way to Switch 2
items.description:
As if this season wasn't packed enough with games to play, the acclaimed 'Nemesis system' Lord of the Rings games Shadow of Mordor and Shadow of War finally come to Switch 2 later this month.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard to take "a somewhat different approach" to level-scaling in Diablo 5, suggesting more influence from Diablo 2 than Diablo 4
items.description:
Blizzard has hinted at yet another core mechanic in Diablo 5 seemingly inspired by Diablo 2. Notably, the in-development action-RPG will tackle level-scaling differently from the way it's done in Diablo 4.

Read more

items.title: Former Halo leaders lament effective closure of Halo Studios, as one employee finds themselves promoted and fired in same week
items.description:
Former Halo leaders Bonnie Ross and Kiki Wolfkill have added their voices to the chorus of people wishing laid-off Halo Studios employees well after Microsoft's drastic downsizing of the studio yesterday.

Read more

items.title: Stellar Blade is a success now but once came close to the brink: "We could only pay salaries for about three months"
items.description:
Shift UP CEO Hyung-Tae Kim has spoken about the troubles faced during Stellar Blade's development, including doubts from investors about the game's ability to break even, and rapidly depleting funds to pay staff with.

Read more

items.title: Age of Empires studio World's Edge reportedly lost "nearly half" of its staff during yesterday's Xbox cuts and move to Activision
items.description:
Yesterday's Xbox cuts saw organisational restructuring that moved Age of Empires studio World's Edge under Activision's control. The initial announcement did not specify whether the Age of Empire studio would lose any staff as part of this transition, but new information has emerged suggesting many members of the team have been let go.

Read more

items.title: Star Wars Zero Company finds success in passing 1m sales, so can the furloughed development team be reinstated and paid now?
items.description:
Star Wars Zero Company, the XCOM-like turn-based tactics game from Bit Reactor, appears to have been a success, selling more than 1m copies, according to estimates from industry analyst Alinea Analytics.

Read more

items.title: Xbox lays off Gears of War: E-Day's story director barely two weeks before the game's launch
items.description:
The story director for Gears of War: E-Day has been laid off as part of yesterday's Xbox cuts, barely two weeks before the game he's worked on for more than four years is released.

Read more

items.title: State of Decay studio Undead Labs goes independent after Xbox restructuring, but lays off "a significant number" of the team in doing so
items.description:
State of Decay studio Undead Labs has shared good and bad news following Xbox's second round of job cuts this year.

Read more

items.title: Artist who hand-paints some of gaming's best fantasy world maps brings them together in oversized and extremely lavish art book
items.description:
If you're an enjoyer of video game maps, you might like this: celebrated artist and cartographer Francesca Baerald - who's created in-game (and out) maps for Dragon Age, Warcraft, Octopath Traveler, Diablo, Dungeons & Dragons and many more - is releasing a glossy new art book. It's an oversized, A3 book that features page after page of her sumptuously detailed, hand-painted maps.

Read more

items.title: Xbox confirms 268 more layoffs, further studio closures, and Obsidian's shift to Bethesda as major restructuring continues
items.description:
Following reports that further job cuts were imminent at Xbox, Microsoft has confirmed more sweeping changes as its major restructuring continues. As a result, some Xbox studios will combine, others are set for closure, and 268 more layoffs have been announced.

Read more

items.title: Hellblade developer Ninja Theory heading towards closure in new wave of Xbox cuts, as two separate agreements collapse
items.description:
Ninja Theory - developer of the Hellblade series of games, Enslaved: Odyssey to the West, DmC: Devil May Cry, and Heavenly Sword - is entering consultation in preperation for the studio's closure as part of today's sweeping Xbox cuts and layoffs.

Read more

items.title: Next major Halo game being developed by Activision, as Halo Studios all but closes as part of Microsoft's Xbox restructuring
items.description:
Halo Studios (formerly 343 Industries) won't develop the next mainline Halo game because it's being what sounds like drastically reduced in size. Microsoft has instead given development duty to Activision, which is making "a new purpose-built team" separate to Call of Duty to make it.

Read more

items.title: Sony appears to be testing PlayStation Store credit offers when you buy certain games
items.description:
Sony appears to be testing a new PlayStation rewards programme. A number of posts on social media and Reddit have recently appeared showing that purchasing certain games from the PlayStation Store now comes with an associated wallet credit bonus.

Read more

items.title: Blizzard layoffs are reportedly imminent,  days after an exciting BlizzCon and a seemingly popular World of Warcraft: Forever beta
items.description:
UPDATE 4PM BST: Game Developer has reportedly seen an email Blizzard sent to employees that indicates it - or at least the World of Warcraft department - isn't affected by "today's announcements". An Xbox representative apparently verified the email's legitimacy.

Read more

items.title: Another Injustice 3 leak reveals two characters in the rumoured DC fighting game - one that's expected and one that's a big surprise
items.description:
We now have even more confirmation a new Injustice game is in development. Following last week's playtest leak, information has emerged that sheds more light on the upcoming DC fighting game.

Read more

items.title: World of Warcraft fans are torn about whether Forever's Skyborne starting zone fits tonally with Classic WoW
items.description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's beta is here, offering us our first look at WoW's reimagined vanilla or classic experience, and already it's proving extremely popular. But there are points of contention, one being whether the new Skyborne race's starting zone fits tonally with original-race zones.

Read more

items.title: Second wave of Xbox cuts reported to be happening this week, with "several" studios apparently facing consolidation
items.description:
Xbox is reportedly preparing to lay off hundreds more people this week as the company plans to consolidate several of its studios.

Read more

items.title: Weeks before GTA 6, Rockstar Games imposes new guidelines that restrict mods for missions, maps, updated storylines, and third-party IP
items.description:
Ahead of the bottomless GTA 6 mods we'll surely get whenever the crime epic finally comes to PC, Rockstar Games has imposed new restrictions on the modding community and, boy, they are tight.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo Switch ports of Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire look even more likely after official account shares suspiciously HD footage of the GBA games
items.description:
Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire might join their handheld third-generation siblings on a journey to the Nintendo Switch - at least, that's what fans think after an official channel posted what looks like a HD version of the classic games that are definitely not running on a Game Boy Advance.

Read more
